questions.title: What is recursion?
questions.answer: Recursion occurs when a function calls itself, directly or indirectly, to solve smaller instances of a problem.
questions.underTheHood: Recursive calls create additional active function executions. Without an appropriate stopping condition, recursion can exhaust the call stack.
pitfalls: Deep recursion may cause stack overflow.
Recursive solutions can have additional stack-space costs.
